column2: the household split does not exist
column3: v1018-D658/D659. Elects one displayName per person and demotes the rest; deletes kinship words outright. Merged, tested, and PRESENT in the shipped v1.0.26 DMG (verified byte-identical to main under OstlerInstaller.app/Contents/Resources/ostler_fda/). Nothing calls it. It CANNOT be auto-wired to --apply: main() refuses to write unless a household-split marker exists (default ~/.ostler/household-split.done, override OSTLER_HOUSEHOLD_SPLIT_MARKER), and NOTHING in this repo creates that marker -- grep is zero outside the module and its guard test. Measured 2026-08-15 against the shipped copy with a stub graph: --apply without the marker exits 2 and writes nothing; with the marker it applies. Passing --households-already-split from install.sh would assert an environmental fact no one measured, on a pass that deletes names with no undo. The trigger is UNRECORDED: neither the module, tests/test_name_repair.sh nor the workflow says once/scheduled/on-demand; the docstring shows manual CLI use only. Andy to choose the trigger.

Sibling repair pass in the same directory, same shape, same problem: it ships and nothing invokes it. Found by the same census that found the row above, which is the point of counting rather than remembering. Not diagnosed here beyond reachability -- do not wire it on the strength of this row alone.
